notes:
DEVIATION FROM THE CARD: the card proposed family-config/ScpiDriver, but LPX200.py builds each line from parts ('OPMODE=' + value at LPX200.py:109-111, 'MODE=' + self.modes[m] at LPX200.py:122, and the REPRATE=, HV= and EGY= prefixes at LPX200.py:126, 142 and 158) and has no transport class. A ScpiDriver command map cannot reproduce a value assembled at run time without changing the wire syntax, so this package is a direct Driver over the entry symbol LPX200:Control, with native.py opening the same pyvisa ASRL4::INSTR resource with CR terminators (LPX200.py:266-270). The fake defines the single public method evaluate, which exists on LPX200.Control: the class stores the commRes query function as self.evaluate and calls it with the command text (LPX200.py:92, 98 and 283); every line the driver sends is a line the clone builds or names. Risk is R3, above the card's R0 floor: the device reads and sets a charging high voltage in kV (LPX200.py:61 and 142; README.md:71), and MHS-004 section 2.1 lists high voltage as R3. SAFE-045 is met by the x-cap.andrewvp41.emission_off.v1 action declared safe_state=True (OPMODE=OFF, the RUN STOP stop command, README.md:58-59); the clone has no separate emergency-stop input, so no estop_physical_ref is cited. The @estop sends the same OPMODE=OFF. The repetition rate, charging voltage and energy have no range in any text file of the clone, so each of those writes is Limit.operator_required and is refused with MHS.SAFETY.LIMITS_UNSET until site-limits.json supplies the rated range; site-limits.example.json uses arbitrary example numbers (1-100 Hz, 15-30 kV, 1-100 mJ) that are not device facts and must be replaced by the operator. NOT COVERED: the gas maintenance routines OPMODE=NEW FILL, FLUSH LINE, PURGE LINE, PURGE RESERVOIR and ENERGY CAL (LPX200.py:132-170, README.md:90-94), MENU RESET (LPX200.py:152-154), the pulse counters (COUNTS=0, LPX200.py:144-146) and the F1-F10 keys (LPX200.py:241-243); the reads cover OPMODE?, TRIGGER?, MODE?, REPRATE?, HV?, EGY?, PRESSURE? and the gas mixture field of Menu?, while the gas menu number and wavelength fields of Menu? are not exposed. The fake's starting values are placeholders marked in fake.py, not facts; it is an in-memory stand-in because the clone contains no simulator or recorded session (the card's preferred transcript does not exist). native.py imports pyvisa lazily and was never imported or run by the gate; no hardware was attached, no hardware backend was run, and reviewed_by stays null. The upstream clone has no licence file; the card records NOASSERTION and no upstream code is copied. The last gate run passed G1-G9 with no finding and no warning; check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run and is not part of the package.
